method: Exact analytic capsule/disk projection of the existing lever into the retained spindle Y strip, at 1441 common-Time samples. Projection is conservative after ignoring existing bores. No geometry proposal and no continuous certificate.

left.relation: A full R16mm capsule starting at V+deltaZ is conservatively separated by Z from the old lever in its Y strip if deltaZ - .016 > sup(forward projection) + desired clearance. A fork/transition shape can obey a less conservative exact-body constraint; this is not a suggested dimension.

right.relation: A full R16mm capsule starting at V+deltaZ is conservatively separated by Z from the old lever in its Y strip if deltaZ - .016 > sup(forward projection) + desired clearance. A fork/transition shape can obey a less conservative exact-body constraint; this is not a suggested dimension.
